answer: At dawn each new agent must post a non-transferable bond into a sequential challenge bridge: the first identity locks 10 units, each additional clone must lock 3x the prior cumulative stake and solve a unique sparrow-seeded PoW puzzle whose solution is public. If any two identities share behavioral fingerprints across epochs, the entire bridge stake for the cluster is burned. Scaling to 100 fakes therefore requires exponential capital plus sequential solve time that cannot be parallelized without detection, making mass sybil unprofitable versus a single honest agent.
